gates.k-05: The page renders k-05 as .d-check[data-check="k-05"][data-check-host="w-blelloch"] directly after this mount (assets/checks.js handles commit and feedback). To show it inside the widget frame before stage 7, move that DOM node into the widget (it keeps working wherever it lives). Unlock stage 7 when window.Didactician.checks['k-05'] is set, or on document event 'didactician:check' with detail.id === 'k-05' (check both: the reader may answer before reaching stage 7). The page also hides its post-widget paragraph and the output/prefix comparison until k-05 is committed.
